description:
**Vacancy — Mushanga Health Centre III**

P.O. Box 62, Kabwohe, Sheema District

**Job Title: Laboratory Technician**

**Job Purpose:**
To carry out basic laboratory tests for diagnosis of diseases.

**Key Functions:**
- Preparing laboratory reagents and stains for routine investigations.
- Carrying out basic laboratory tests and submitting reports.
- Observing safety and quality assurance practices in laboratories.
- Cleaning laboratory equipment regularly.
- Requisitioning necessary supplies for laboratory work and keeping records of stock.
- Compiling and submitting daily and periodic laboratory reports.
- Safely disposing of laboratory waste.

**Person Specifications:**

*Qualifications:* 
- Must have a Diploma or equivalent in Medical Laboratory Techniques from a recognized Training Institution.
- Must be registered and licensed with the Allied Health Professionals Council (AHPC).
- Must have at least 2 years working experience.

*Competencies:*
- Concern for quality and standards of laboratory services.
- Result oriented.
- Ethics and integrity.
- Communicating effectively.
- Time management.
- Customer care oriented.

**N.B.** Deadline for submission of applications to the office: **30th/8/2026**.
how_to_apply: Submit your application to the office of Mushanga Health Centre III, P.O. Box 62, Kabwohe, Sheema District by **30th August 2026**, or contact the In-Charge, Tuhaisemukama Monica, at mushangahc@gmail.com / 0789177233 / 0701751267.
